rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: both Eisenhower letters open by regretfully accepting a Cabinet secretary's resignation effective upon the qualification of a successor, proceed through an extended appraisal of the official's abilities and national service, and then preserve an advisory role through future consultations. That combination of close language and parallel structure is materially stronger than generic resignation-letter conventions. C15 and C14 share important subsidiary elements, but neither matches the child's full sequence as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I accept, with deepest personal regret and only because I have no alternative, your resignation as Secretary of State, effective upon the qualification of your successor.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I nevertheless regret that the time is now at hand when I must accept your resignation as Director, Office of Defense Mobilization, effective on the qualification of your successor.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical operative opening: personal regret, compelled acceptance, named office, and effectiveness upon the successor's qualification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You have, with the talents you so abundantly possess ... employed your rich heritage as well as your unique experience in handling our relations with other countries.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have drawn constant reassurance from the fact that your many abilities were devoted to the vital task ... your vision and sound judgment have been of the highest value. The nation has indeed profited by your dedication to this service.
shared_material.explanation: Both follow acceptance with a sustained evaluation of the departing official's abilities, judgment, dedication, and national contribution.

shared_material.child_excerpt: By this letter I request you to serve in the future ... as a consultant to me and the State Department in international affairs.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am glad that you can continue as a member of the Committee and will be available for further consultations from time to time.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the substantive portion by arranging continued service or consultation after resignation.
